namespace.description: Short namespace identifier for metadata scoping (e.g. "crm", "todo")

objects.description: Glob patterns for ObjectQL schemas files

secret.description: If true, value is encrypted/masked (e.g. API Keys)

properties.description: Map of configuration keys to their definitions

id.description: The generic identifier of the kind (e.g., "sys.bi.report")

description.description: Description of what this kind represents

data.description: Initial seed data (prefer top-level data field)

implements.description: List of protocols this plugin conforms to

specification.description: URL or path to protocol specification

sinceVersion.description: Version when this feature was added

provides.description: Services/APIs this plugin offers to others

requiredCapabilities.description: Protocol IDs the dependency must support

extensionPoints.description: Points where other plugins can extend this plugin

cardinality.description: Whether multiple extensions can register to this point

loading.description: Plugin loading and runtime behavior configuration

preload.description: Preload module in parallel with parent

critical.description: If true, kernel bootstrap fails if plugin fails

healthCheckInterval.description: Health check interval in ms (0 = disabled)

watchPatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to watch

ignorePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to ignore

onError.description: Function to call on reload error

healthValidation.description: Run health checks after reload before accepting traffic

rollbackOnFailure.description: Auto-rollback if reloaded plugin fails health check

healthTimeout.description: Health check timeout after reload in ms

drainConnections.description: Gracefully drain active requests before reloading

drainTimeout.description: Max wait time for connection draining in ms

maxConcurrentReloads.description: Limit concurrent reloads to prevent system instability

minReloadInterval.description: Cooldown period between reloads of the same plugin

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds (0 = infinite)

scope.description: Which plugins are subject to isolation

enabled.description: Allow sandboxed plugins to communicate via IPC

maxMessageSize.description: Maximum IPC message size in bytes (default 1MB)

timeout.description: IPC message response timeout in ms

allowedServices.description: Service names the sandboxed plugin may invoke via IPC

objectstack.description: ObjectStack platform version requirement (SemVer range, e.g. ">=3.0.0")

enableOnInstall.description: Whether to enable immediately after install

platformVersion.description: Current platform version for compatibility verification
